title: Multi-transport reconciliation of Briakos annotations.js lineage and reported size metric
required_cross_verifier_equalities: latest path-change blob equals historical blob
zero repository-visible revisions satisfying both published byte count and published SHA-256 prefix
required_size_metric_fact: The published numeric value 2201442 must equal exactly one predeclared decoded-text measurement and must not equal raw UTF-8 byte length.

decision_rule.MULTI_TRANSPORT_RECONCILED_CHARACTER_COU: Both source-lineage implementations agree on all frozen fields, both classify the same metadata conflict, and the size-metric verifier finds full Unicode code-point count == 2201442 as the unique predeclared match.
decision_rule.TRANSPORT_DISAGREEMENT: Any frozen cross-verifier lineage field differs.
decision_rule.SIZE_METRIC_UNRESOLVED: Lineage agrees but no unique predeclared size metric explains 2201442.
